      "rationale": "A pending IRQ at trigger and a trap raised after its dispatch mask was captured are different histories. The handler can execute its first opcode before the next sample; the plan no longer forces an earlier mock callback.",

      "section": "Reconciled budget and bounded terminal result",
      "evidence": "D1 now canonically uses C+W unless it lies inside the autostart prelude, then measured prelude length+W. After load,0 and exactly W compared cycles/2W half-cycles the run must terminate by the limit or a gate quit within the recorded overshoot allowance; permit count, retained tail and exit reason are required. Waiting on an unsupplied permit, early stop or stretched window is rejected.",
